titleZh: 節儉 ↔ 揮霍｜存錢筒對碎鈔機
hook: frugal／husband（勤儉）抱存錢筒，profligate／lavish 餵碎鈔機——會計在旁邊默默流淚。
script: 節儉隊：frugal／thrifty／provident／sparing／husband。揮霍隊：profligate／lavish／extravagant／spendthrift。口令：存錢筒寫「能省則省」，碎鈔機寫「今夜不回家」。

members.speakLineEn: A frugal student cooked rice and vegetables instead of ordering delivery nightly.
members.speakLineZh: 節儉的學生自己煮飯菜，而不是每晚叫外送。

members.speakLineEn: Thrifty shoppers compared thrift-store jackets before buying anything new.
members.speakLineZh: 節約的購物者會先比較二手店外套，再決定是否買新的。

members.speakLineEn: Sparing in their use of heat and light.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：吝惜使用的。

members.speakLineEn: Taking the tram proved more economical than driving and paying for parking.
members.speakLineZh: 搭電車比開車再付停車費更節省。

members.speakLineEn: Campers must husband drinking water carefully on the long dry ridge trail.
members.speakLineZh: 在漫長乾燥山脊步道上，露營者必須勤儉持家般珍惜飲用水。

members.speakLineEn: His profligate spending on gadgets left him broke before rent was due.
members.speakLineZh: 他對電子產品揮霍無度，租金到期前就破產了。

members.speakLineEn: The club threw a lavish welcome banquet that used up half the semester budget.
members.speakLineZh: 社團辦了一場奢華歡迎宴，花掉半個學期的預算。

members.speakLineEn: Nobody wanted a spendthrift roommate who ordered takeout three times a day.
members.speakLineZh: 沒人想要一個一天點三次外送的揮霍無度室友。

related.synonyms: spend-all, spender, scattergood, extravagant, prodigal, profligate

members.speakLineEn: Leaving classroom lights on all night is wasteful and raises the utility bill.
members.speakLineZh: 教室燈整晚不關既浪費，又推高水電費。

members.speakLineEn: An improvident decision to skip saving left him stranded without emergency cash.
members.speakLineZh: 不節儉又沒遠見地跳過存錢，讓他陷入沒有應急現金的困境。

members.speakLineEn: Do not squander the quiet weekend on endless scrolling when drafts still wait.
members.speakLineZh: 草稿還在等你時，別把安靜週末浪費在無盡滑手機上。

members.speakLineEn: He would dissipate his stipend on gadgets and then borrow money for food.
members.speakLineZh: 他會把津貼浪費在小裝置上，然後再借錢買吃的。

related.synonyms: disperse, dispel, scatter, fritter, shoot, fool

members.speakLineEn: She dropped spare coins into a ceramic piggybank labeled for summer travel.
members.speakLineZh: 她把零錢投進標示「暑假旅行」的陶瓷存錢筒。

members.speakLineEn: Old bank statements went into the office shredder before the recycling bin.
members.speakLineZh: 舊銀行對帳單先丟進辦公室碎紙機，再進回收桶。

members.speakLineEn: The treasurer kept a neat ledger of every ticket sale for the spring play.
members.speakLineZh: 財務長用整齊帳本記錄春季舞台劇每一筆售票。

members.speakLineEn: A grocery coupon for pasta sauce saved enough for an extra loaf of bread.
members.speakLineZh: 一張義大利麵醬折扣券，省下的錢剛好多買一條麵包。

members.speakLineEn: The museum case displayed a rare goldcoin from a nineteenth-century shipwreck.
members.speakLineZh: 博物館展櫃陳列一枚來自十九世紀沉船的罕見金幣。

members.speakLineEn: Our club budget must cover both costumes and the rental of stage lights.
members.speakLineZh: 我們社團預算必須同時負擔戲服與舞台燈光租金。

members.speakLineEn: After months of saving, they decided to splurge on one fancy birthday dinner.
members.speakLineZh: 存了好幾個月後，他們決定揮霍一次、吃頓豪華生日晚餐。

members.speakLineEn: Her summer savings covered textbooks and still left money for weekend bus fare.
members.speakLineZh: 她的暑假存款夠付課本，還剩錢付週末公車費。

members.speakLineEn: The bank teller stamped VOID on the voidcheck and handed it back for records.
members.speakLineZh: 銀行櫃員在廢支票上蓋上 VOID，再交還給她留存紀錄。
